name: Leo's Customizer
description: One-click customizations in the bottom-left sidebar, in groups: Look, Sidebar, Chat, Quick toggles, Actions. Each row shows its current value.

scopes.settings:read: Show each row's current value (theme file, densities, text sizes, on or off).
scopes.actions:run: Run the cmux action a row names when you click it (sidebar density, animations, open Settings at a row, start a Customize chat).
